newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 2.254 billion yuan from 2.764 billion yuan
on Tuesday with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was less active on a lack of market-moving news, traders said.
Official statistics published on Tuesday said China's broad M2 money supply increased by a year-on-year 20.6 percent in the first four months of this year.

Traders said this meant China still faced inflationary pressure though retail price inflation fell to 1.1 percent in April against a year-on-year 6.1 percent for the whole of last year. The contradictory factors would make the interbank rates move in a narrow range in the short term, they said.
